title: agentest failure registry entry
description: One reproducible agent failure: a recorded trace that agentest checks fail, the checks that fail it, and (optionally) a fixed run that passes them. Entries are re-run by scripts/run_registry.py in CI.

id.description: Stable ID, issued in order and never reused. The file name is <id>.json.

title.description: One line: what the agent did wrong, in plain words.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what was tested, what happened, what a fix looks like. Scoped to the example and version named in target; not a verdict on a framework or model.

status.description: reproducible: CI re-runs it and gets the expected verdicts. fixed-upstream: the cause was fixed by the owner of the code. needs-review: submitted, not yet confirmed by a maintainer. withdrawn: kept for its ID only.

taxonomy_version.description: Version of docs/taxonomy/TAXONOMY.md the category and ASI IDs refer to.

asi.description: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications entries the failing checks map to. May be empty. Must be covered by the mapping of the failing checks.

failing_checks.description: Check IDs that fail on the original run. Must equal the checks expected to fail in variants.original.

description.description: What was run: the example, agent or workflow, in neutral words.

version.description: Version or commit of the thing tested, when it has one.

scope_note.description: What the finding does not say.

command.description: A command that regenerates the recorded traces from the repository root.

offline.description: True when the command needs no model, key or network.

requires.description: Anything beyond `pip install agentest-ai`, for example a pinned framework version.

judge.description: The agentest command that prints the verdicts for the original run.

variants.description: original is the failing run. fixed, when present, is a run of the corrected agent or tool contract.

lab.description: Repository-relative path to the Failure Lab case or write-up.

external_registries.description: Cross-links to public incident registries, only where a record describes the same kind of failure. Never required.

registry.description: For example AVID or the Agent Incident Registry.

trace.description: Repository-relative path to a recorded OTLP trace (.otlp.json or .otlp.jsonl).

card.description: Repository-relative path to an A2A AgentCard, if the checks need one.

tools.description: Repository-relative path to an MCP tools/list file, if the checks need one.

expected_verdicts.description: Check ID to the verdict agentest must give on this trace. CI fails if any differs.
